name: rentprog
description: Your RentProg rental-fleet data and actions for AI agents via MCP — CRM, fleet and bookings, money, staff — with per-area access levels (read, write with approval, with preview, immediately), plus five ready-made skills: morning brief, debtors, fleet load, client dossier, period summary.

api_token.title: RentProg personal agent key
api_token.description: Issued in RentProg → Profile → “AI agent keys”. Starts with rpa_. Acts on your behalf and sees exactly what you see.

api_url.title: RentProg MCP endpoint
api_url.description: RentProg → Profile → “AI agent keys” shows the MCP server address for your company; it depends on your country and region.
